notes: shares 31B2:0111 with the Kiwi Ears Allegro Mini (chip KT0211L): this unit has the chip KT02H20 and is told apart by the exact USB product name
manufacturer string KTMicro, bcdDevice 0x0001, HID interface 3, report 0x4B with 10 data bytes
same register protocol as the Allegro Mini: byte 0 register, byte 4 0x52 read / 0x57 write / 0x53 save, value in bytes 6-9
devicePEQ (usbDeviceConfig.js, entry "KT02H20 HIFI Audio"): 5 PK bands, +-12 dB, no shelves, no preamp, frequency written at half its value; its "no re-enumeration after save" is wrong for this unit

Global Gain: register 0x3B takes [step, 0, 0, 0] for steps 1-15, is acknowledged and reads back, and the 1 kHz output level follows it by about 1.5 dB per step, the Allegro Mini's scale (1-15 = -18..+3 dB, 13 = 0 dB); the unit ships at step 9 (about -6 dB) (run:2026-11-10-jcally-jm12-06-mac-gain-probe)

on the Mac, in about 45 SAVEs with an audio stream playing, the unit twice failed to come back properly (once it stayed off the bus, once it came back but did not answer HID) until it was unplugged and plugged in; the app ends such a send as not confirmed and asks for a replug.

register 0x66 byte 0 took 0, -2, -6, -12 and -24 and read them back, but the output level did not change (under 0.01 dB): it is not a preamp and stays unwritten (run:2026-11-10-jcally-jm12-06-mac-gain-probe)
measured on the unit: it leaves the USB bus after every SAVE and is back after about 0.8 s (run:2026-11-10-jcally-jm12-01-mac)

register 0x24: byte 0 is the EQ switch (read back as written), bytes 1-3 are device status that changes by itself (03 00 00 02 / 03 00 00 00 after saves): written as [eq, 0, 0, 0], verified on byte 0 only; bands, edges and both shelf types (codes 3 and 4) were accepted and read back byte for byte (run:2026-11-10-jcally-jm12-01-mac)

offered above devicePEQ, as far as the unit was measured to play (acoustic runs 2026-11-10-jcally-jm12-05 to -10, tolerance 0.5 dB to Contour's model, owner decision 10.11 "only what was measured"): peaks +-12 dB with Q 0.2-10 (Q 0.1 was 0.98 dB off), low and high shelf +-6 dB with Q 0.7-1.0 (at +-9..12 dB they were 0.7-1.0 dB off; Q was measured at 0.71 and 1.0 only), register frequency from 10 Hz

rangesAccepted.note: PK +-12 dB, Q 0.1-10, register 10-10000 Hz (intended 20-20000 Hz) and LS/HS (codes 3 and 4) written and read back on the Mac; the record offers the part that also plays as drawn: PK Q 0.2-10, shelves +-6 dB at Q 0.7-1.0.

acoustic.note: Biquads designed for 24 kHz and run at the 48 kHz stream, shelf Q = register Q. Within 0.5 dB for PK +-12 dB at Q 0.2-10 and for shelves up to +-6 dB at Q 0.71 and 1.0; PK at Q 0.1 and shelves at +-9 to 12 dB were 0.7-1.0 dB off, so they are not offered.

persistence.note: Five-band edge profile sent from a Nothing Phone (3a), unplugged and plugged back in: the cold read equals the frames sent.

settings.note: EQ switch OFF and ON from the phone and Global Gain 9 -> 8 -> 9 on the Mac, each with SAVE and a read after the reconnect. Global Gain measured at 1.5 dB per step. Register 0x66 takes values but changes nothing, so it is not offered.

tested.beyondVendor: JCally publishes no EQ tool. Against devicePEQ's five peaking bands Contour adds low and high shelves (up to +-6 dB), Q up to 10 and the Global Gain output level (15 steps of 1.5 dB; the unit ships at step 9, about 6 dB below step 13).
